canada.title: Police identify man shot and killed during home invasion in affluent Toronto neighbourhood
canada.summary: A man was shot and killed during a home invasion in an affluent Toronto neighbourhood early Wednesday morning, police say. The victim has been identified as 39-year-old Michael Eckert.

canada.summary: The Edmonton Elks and the Canadian Football League announced that the 2028 Grey Cup will be held in Edmonton. The last time Commonwealth Stadium hosted a Grey Cup was in 2018, when the Calgary Stampeders beat the Ottawa Redblacks 27-16.

canada.title: Man sentenced to life for ‘heinous’ shotgun slaying
